text: watcheth for thee: Heb. awaketh against thee
their multitude: Or, their tumultuous persons. Heb. tumult
although they were yet alive: Heb. though their life were yet among the living | in the iniquity of his life: Or, whose life is in his iniquity. Heb. his iniquity
shall be weak as water: Heb. go into water
removed: Heb. for a separation or uncleanness | because it is the stumbling block of their iniquity: Or, because their iniquity is their stumbling block
set it far from them: Or, made it unto them an unclean thing
their holy places shall be defiled: Or, they shall inherit their holy places
according to: Heb. with their judgments
